manifest.description: Host a multiplayer music quiz game where guests join with a QR code.

mode.label: Playback Mode
mode.description: How the quiz rounds are played. In venue mode a configured player plays the music out loud for everyone in the room. In remote mode every guest listens on their own device (silent-disco style).

options.remote: Remote (guests listen on their own device)

player.label: Quiz Player
player.description: The player that plays the quiz rounds in venue mode. When set to auto, the last active player is used.

use_ai_distractors.label: Enhance the Experience with AI
use_ai_distractors.description: When enabled, the quiz uses a configured AI provider (such as Home Assistant, which provides LLM access) to enhance the experience — for example, generating more convincing fake answers for each round. Falls back to the built-in behavior when no AI provider is available.

ai_unavailable.label: AI enhancements are currently unavailable because no compatible AI provider is configured.
